title: torque_task_data_emit input@1
description: Emit structured data for a task as data.emitted. Inline data is capped at 16 KiB serialized; larger bodies go in an artifact first and are referenced by artifact_id. Not gated by progress_detail.

run_id.description: Torque run id (numeric, as a string); must belong to task_id

data.description: inline data, at most 16384 bytes serialized

artifact_id.description: Torque artifact id (numeric, as a string); must belong to task_id
